chunks: With this chain, from Abi al-Mi'za, from Abi Basir, from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The Surahs starting with Ha Mim are the fragrances of the Quran. So when you recite them, praise Allah and thank Him abundantly for their preservation and recitation. Indeed, a person stands and recites the Ha Mim Surahs, and the best scent of musk al-athfar and amber emerges from his mouth. And indeed, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, shows mercy to those who memorize them and those who recite them, and shows mercy to their neighbors, friends, acquaintances, and every close relative and dear one. And indeed, on the Day of Judgment, the Throne, the Kursi, and the nearest angels of Allah seek forgiveness for him.

key_terms.الْحَوَامِیمُ: The seven Surahs of the Quran that begin with the letters Ha Mim
key_terms.الْمِسْکِ الْأَذْفَرِ: Musk al-athfar, a high-quality type of musk

ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual rewards of reciting the Ha Mim Surahs in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, the 'Ha Mim' Surahs (Al-A'raf to Al-Dukhan) are revered as the 'fragrances' of the Quran, a metaphor for their spiritual purity and ability to elevate the soul. This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq emphasizes the communal and cosmic scope of this reward, noting that divine mercy extends not only to the reciter but also to their neighbors, friends, and even the Throne and angels interceding on their behalf. The mention of a fragrance 'more pleasant than musk' underscores the tangible spiritual transformation experienced by the believer through consistent recitation.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. From the previous chain from Abi al-Mi’za from Abi Basir from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “

Surahs starting with Ha Mim are best fragrance of the Holy Quran. Praise and glorify Allah excessively whenever you recite them. Whenever a person recites them, his mouth smells far better than musk and amber. Allah showers His mercy on the reciter, his neighbors, friends, relatives and near and dear ones. The Divine throne, Kursi and nearest angels would repent for him on the Day of Judgment.”
